name: Milan Games Week & Cartoomics
blurb: Italy's comics, manga, cosplay and video-game fair, now run jointly with Milan Games Week at Fiera Milano.

editions.evidence: Affaritaliani (14 Sep 2026): 'Dal 27 al 29 novembre Fiera Milano ospiterà tra gli altri Emily Rudd, Taz Skylar, Steven Ogg e Christopher Judge.'

notes: The official site (milangamesweek.it; cartoomics.it redirects there too) renders a completely blank page to headless Chromium even with the msedge channel and extra wait time, so dates/guests/cover had to come from press coverage instead of the site itself. Only 4 international screen guests are confirmed via that article (framed as the most-anticipated among a larger lineup, which also includes comics creators not named in that piece); the official guest page almost certainly lists more names once it can be read, so this list should be treated as partial.
